name: Construtora Tenda S.A.
summary: Construtora Tenda S.A. operates as a construction company for homes in Brazil. It operates through On-Site and Off-Site segments. The company also engages in the execution and management of civil construction works; development of real estate; purchase and sale of real estate and land; provision of civil construction management services; and intermediation and marketing of consortium shares. Construtora Tenda S.A. was founded in 1969 is headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil.
